subject: Simple condition-name condition (conditional variable)
notes: cite.py --check 8.8.4.5.3 "including the end values" -> OK §8.8.4.5.3 1). A THRU range renders as inclusive >= lo && <= hi (numeric scaled, float double, string via CobolString.Compare or ThruMember under checking); multiple ranges OR together. Probed (probe out/probe/cn/p1.cob (--std 2023), p3.cob (--std 85), p2.cob/p4.cob (2023/2002)): S9(3)V99 VALUE -10 THRU -1.5 true at -10 and -1.5, false at -1.49; VALUE 1 THRU 2, 5, 7.25 THRU 8 true at 2, 5, 7.25, 8, false at 2.01 and 8.01; COMP-3 100 THRU 200 true at 200, false at 201; PIC X(5) "B" THRU "D" true at B and D, false at A and DA. Identical under --std 85. The golden derives FTTTTTFFFF / FTTFFFFFTT from GR1 + §14.7.8 rule 1. [editions as adjudicated: 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 (§8.8.4.5 carries no edition marking; the simple condition-name condition is base COBOL in every edition)]
